_comment: Simplified Chinese texts for the German table fan_wake. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.A very rich stranger: 一位非常有钱的陌生人
strings.The Heir smiles at the will. Bright futu: 继承人对着遗嘱微笑。前途光明！
strings.The Heir stands up: \"This Wayfarer paid: 继承人站起来：“这位旅人给了我钱。真感人。”大厅鸦雀无声。
strings.The Heir winks and sniffs loudly. Very m: 继承人眨眨眼，大声抽鼻子。非常感人。
strings.The Heir yawns. Get on with the reading: 继承人打了个哈欠。快念遗嘱吧。
殡仪师点点头。跟土挺配。
strings.The Undertaker: Bring a Spirling, perfor: 殡仪师：带一只Spirling来，在棺材旁表演一个技艺。哭丧人为眼泪付钱。
strings.The Undertaker: No fire near the coffin,: 殡仪师：棺材附近请勿用火。
strings.The Undertaker: Not today. The dead were: 殡仪师：今天不行。死者没被打动。
strings.The Undertaker: One funeral a day. The d: 殡仪师：一天一场葬礼。死者很有耐心。明天再来。
strings.The Undertaker: Today we mourn %s. Who w: 殡仪师：今天我们悼念%s。谁来表演？
strings.The Undertaker: Welcome to the Wake. Eve: 殡仪师：欢迎来到守灵会。每天都有人带着钱、没有朋友地死去。
寡妇擦了擦眼睛。真好。真阴沉。
strings.The Widow: Too cheerful. Nobody is sad e: 寡妇：太欢快了。没人够伤心。
strings.The hall weeps for you. You win %d coins: 大厅为你落泪。你赢得%d金币。
strings.The man who sold the bridge twice: 把一座桥卖了两次的那个人
